data.name: Nazeerah
data.gender_notes: Nazeerah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘n-z-r’ which means ‘to see, observe, inspect’. In Islamic traditions, Nazeerah symbolizes the ability to see beyond the physical realm, possessing a deep understanding and insight. The name Nazeerah carries the meaning “Inspector, observer” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nazeerah usually hope their child will grow to embody inspector, observer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name imbued with spiritual significance, signifying insight and wisdom.
data.etymology: Nazeerah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Inspector, observer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nazeerah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Nazeerah carries deep meaning as it relates to the ability to perceive and understand the unseen. In Islamic teachings, it's emphasized that this world is only a small part of a grander reality, and the true test of faith lies in our ability to see beyond the physical realm. Thus, a Nazeerah is someone who has been granted the gift of insight, enabling them to lead a more enlightened and faith-driven life. Islamic scriptures highlight the importance of vision and perception when dealing with situations, and Nazeerah is a reminder of this powerful attribute. The name further inspires individuals to seek knowledge, uncover hidden truths, and understand the deeper reality behind every phenomenon.
